name: motion-craft
description: Launch films from the same story as the keynote: reads story-craft's narrative.md and brand-lock.md, directs each cut (film-60, teaser-20) through direction options, storyboard, motion spec and an animated test, builds in HyperFrames, forges generated shots via any connected video MCP, checks the render with a fresh reviewer and exports one clip per beat (clips.json) so deck-craft can play them on the matching slides. Adds the motion-director, shot-forge and motion-qa skills.
